jobs.summary: Built and scaled AI platforms with multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, event-driven AWS services, and production-ready billing and notification systems.
bullets: Designed and built a scalable AI platform supporting multi-agent workflows and retrieval pipelines across multiple internal use cases.
Implemented state-driven agent execution and RAG, improving response accuracy and reducing repeated processing.
Integrated guardrails and validation mechanisms to increase source-grounded responses and system reliability.
Deployed backend services on AWS ECS/Fargate and EC2 capacity providers with asynchronous pipelines using SNS, SQS, and Lambda to support hundreds of AI tasks per day.
Designed and implemented agentic AI workflows with planning, execution, and verification phases using role-based agents for retrieval, reasoning, and validation.
Integrated Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Perplexity with dynamic model selection, tool-calling, and API orchestration.
Built Lexim Query, a conversational chatbot with document-centric RAG and near-real-time ingestion into AWS Knowledge Bases.
Designed billing schema and AWS Lambda cost pipelines, integrated Stripe subscriptions/webhooks, and built audit-ready reconciliation workflows.
Built event-driven notification pipelines with SNS, SQS, Lambda, and SES, including retry handling and in-app notification persistence.
Led development of RegIntel using React frontend plus Flask/FastAPI backend services with MySQL-backed regulatory intelligence workflows.

jobs.summary: Led frontend delivery of internal web products focused on knowledge discovery, unified access, and secure authentication across internal applications.
bullets: Led frontend development of KeelCompass, an internal knowledge base application to centralize and surface organizational knowledge.
Built a React-based web app focused on usability, performance, and maintainable component architecture.
Translated Figma designs into responsive, production-ready UI components.
Collaborated with stakeholders to improve information architecture and content discoverability.
Designed and implemented KeelHub, a centralized hub for navigating and accessing internal tools.
Contributed to UI and UX design to create a consistent and intuitive entry point across the internal product ecosystem.
Implemented centralized authentication with Google OAuth (SSO) for seamless secure access.
Improved onboarding and access management by unifying identity and navigation under one platform.

jobs.summary: Improved ERP workflows and platform reliability while modernizing frontend code and introducing AWS serverless async processing.
bullets: Enhanced ERP-driven internal workflows, improving operational efficiency by 30% and reducing task completion time from 2 hours to 1.5 hours.
Improved technical issue resolution processes, reducing average resolution time from 24 to 18 hours and increasing overall system uptime.
Developed AWS Lambda functions for asynchronous processing, reducing infrastructure costs and improving response times by 30%.
Refactored legacy frontend codebases to improve maintainability and reduce technical debt, resulting in a 25% performance improvement.

chatBot.title: Ask Shivang
chatBot.initialMessage: Hi! I can answer questions about Shivang's AI full-stack experience, agentic workflows, RAG systems, and cloud architecture work.
suggestions: What AI systems have you built?
Tell me about your work at Lexim AI
What is your core tech stack?
responses: I build production-grade AI systems using RAG, multi-agent workflows, and scalable backend services on AWS.
At Lexim AI, I worked across Praxis AI, Agentic AI systems, Lexim Query, billing pipelines, notifications, and the RegIntel platform.
My core stack includes Python, JavaScript, React, Next.js, FastAPI, Flask, AWS Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SNS, and SQS.
I design agent workflows with planning, execution, and validation, and add guardrails like reflection loops and human-in-the-loop review.
I am open to full-time AI software engineering opportunities and collaboration on production AI systems.
